observation.visible_scene: A white, maze-like track structure with multiple lanes and a central cloud-shaped bay rests on a plain white surface. Numerous small, shiny, multicolored spheres (red, blue, yellow, green, white) are scattered across the track and the surrounding table. A watermark 'AMAKANDU' is visible in the top-left corner.
visible_changes: The camera slowly zooms out and shifts perspective, causing the track structure to appear smaller and move within the frame.
The cluster of spheres in the central bay is in motion, with individual spheres rolling and shifting towards the right-hand exit of the track.
The arrangement of spheres within the central cluster changes as they flow outward, while spheres already on the open table surface to the right remain largely stationary.
Spheres in the upper-left and far-left lanes of the track appear mostly static throughout the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: The mechanism causing the spheres to move (e.g., table tilt, external push) is not visible.
The final resting positions of the spheres are not shown as the clip ends mid-motion.
uncertain_details: The precise distinction between the camera's zoom/pan and the physical movement of the spheres is difficult to separate perfectly, but both are occurring simultaneously.
